data.name: Nordic Storm Solitaire
data.detailed_description:
A Nordic solitaire adventure with 130+ levels, story progression, and rewarding casual gameplay.

Help Northman Elof lead his people to the promised land of the god Feyr in Nordic Storm Solitaire, a charming and challenging card adventure set in a frozen mythic world. Face the ancient rival Jotun Idyl as you journey through a land of winter storms, magical legends, and tactical solitaire puzzles.

Play through 130+ handcrafted levels of solitaire with a progression system designed to keep every stage fresh and rewarding. Earn boosts, unlock helpful tools, and use smart strategies to clear difficult layouts faster and more efficiently. Whether you enjoy relaxing card games or more demanding puzzle challenges, Nordic Storm Solitaire offers a satisfying balance of accessibility and depth.

With beautiful Nordic scenery, story-driven progression, and polished solo gameplay, this is a perfect pick for players who love casual strategy games, atmospheric adventures, and classic solitaire with a modern twist.

  • A mythic solitaire adventure in a frozen Nordic world.

  • Guide Elof through 130+ levels of challenging solitaire.

  • Relaxing card gameplay meets a Nordic fantasy journey.

data.short_description: Help northman Elof lead his people to a land promised by the God Feyr! Beware… this land is under dispute by the Jotun Idyl, an archrival of the ancient Gods. Play through 130 challenging solitaire levels and chase away the Jotun Idyl!
